name: Energy Storage
description: Need for energy storage technologies, energy storage options to balance renewable energy systems, fundamentals of various energy storage technologies, thermal energy storage: sensible and latent heat storage and their optimizations and management, thermochemical heat storage system, electrochemical energy storage: various types of battery storage and their optimizations techniques, mechanical energy storage: pumped storage and flywheel storage systems, electrical energy storage: supercapacitors and superconducting magnetic coils, chemical energy storage: hydrogen energy storage, integration/sizing of energy storage systems and energy storage system optimization.
